from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,sys

profile='build-local/glm-mtp-cache-profile.json'
reference='docs/GLM53/GLM53_FLASH_SYNC_REPEAT.json'
for name,mode,depths in [('control',0,'0,1,2,3'),('new',1,'3,2,1')]:
    path=f'build-local/glm-mtp-cache-{name}-benchmark.json'
    assert not Path(path).exists(),path
    cmd=[sys.executable,'-u','tools/benchmark_glm5next_mtp.py','--profile',profile,
         '--reference',reference,'--output',path,'--depths',depths,'--warmups','4','--repeats','3',
         '--cache-only',str(mode),'--cache-slab-mib','16']
    print('START',name,flush=True)
    subprocess.run(cmd,check=True)
    d=json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    assert d['status']=='pass',d['status']
    print('COMPLETE',name,[(v['depth'],round(v['median_tokens_per_second'],3)) for v in d['variants']],flush=True)
from pathlib import Path
import json, subprocess, sys

profile = 'build-local/glm-mtp-cache-profile.json'
reference = 'docs/GLM53/GLM53_FLASH_SYNC_REPEAT.json'
for part in ('control', 'new'):
    assert json.loads(Path(f'build-local/glm-mtp-cache-{part}-benchmark.json').read_text())['status'] == 'pass'
for name, mode, depth in [('new', 1, 1), ('control', 0, 1), ('off', 1, 0)]:
    output = f'build-local/glm-mtp-cache-confirm-{name}.json'
    assert not Path(output).exists(), output
    cmd = [sys.executable, '-u', 'tools/benchmark_glm5next_mtp.py', '--profile', profile,
           '--reference', reference, '--output', output, '--depths', str(depth),
           '--warmups', '8', '--repeats', '5', '--cache-only', str(mode), '--cache-slab-mib', '16']
    print('START', name, flush=True)
    subprocess.run(cmd, check=True)
    report = json.loads(Path(output).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    assert report['status'] == 'pass'
    print('COMPLETE', name, report['variants'][0]['median_tokens_per_second'], flush=True)
